messages:
jamie: Heads-up — proposing a soft-swap tomorrow 02:00 UTC to move traffic from router-service v2 -> v3.0.2. 15m change window, staged ramp. @sanjay can you sanity-check the weight plan?

sanjay: Ack. Thinking: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 3–5m holds and health checks between steps. Keep read-only traffic pinned to v2 for 30m after full shift.

jamie: Agree. Plan to pin v2 to pool-A for 30m post-shift. Router commands we'll run: 

```bash
# set weights on router (example)
routerctl set-weight --service router-service --version v3.0.2 --weight 5
# after hold
routerctl set-weight --service router-service --version v3.0.2 --weight 25
routerctl set-weight --service router-service --version v3.0.2 --weight 60
routerctl set-weight --service router-service --version v3.0.2 --weight 100
```

Will also tag the release and update release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/router-service-v3-0-2 (draft).

deploy-bot: deploy started: router-service v3.0.2 -> staging -> canary. CI: all checks passed. Canary target: 5% traffic for 3m.

linda: Add rollback trigger: if error-rate > 1.5% sustained over 2m OR latency p95 > 300ms, we rollback to v2 with: 

```bash
# rollback
routerctl set-weight --service router-service --version v3.0.2 --weight 0
routerctl set-weight --service router-service --version v2 --weight 100
```

Also preserve logs and set debug sampling to 50% for the canary. I'll be on-call for the window.

sanjay: Also ensure the canary alerting is wired: prometheus rule for router_service_errors and p95 latency with playbook links. Add short cooldown between weight changes: wait for 3 successful health-check probes.

opsbot: Traffic policy applied: auto-fallback enabled. Canary alarms set -> error_rate > 1.5% (2m), p95 latency > 300ms (2m). Automatic pause if integration failures detected.

maria: I'll run synthetic smoke tests at each ramp step and watch the canary eval dashboard. Will post screenshots and a short log snippet if anything abnormal.

jamie: Nice. I'll update the release note (public) and pin v3.0.2 to dedicated pool-B for tonight's validation run. Change window: 02:00–02:15 UTC tomorrow. Warned PMs and Support. :rocket:

linda: Quick reminder — avoid doing other LB changes in the same window (net team). If we need to abort, we use the rollback commands above and open a P1 channel `#incidents` so SRE can sweep.

jamie: Perfect. Final checklist before window: release notes link, routerctl script staged in ops runbook, ops escalation list, and deploy-bot cron cleared for that hour. I'll post final go/no-go 15m before start.

deploy-bot: scheduled task: soft-swap orchestration script queued for 2950080000 (02:00 UTC). Will emit status updates in this thread during execution.

maria: Thanks — I'll be on watch.

sanjay: LGTM from infra.

linda: LGTM from on-call.

jamie: Thanks team — closing planning.
